description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose component 'ChatMarkdown' that renders markdown-formatted text with custom styling, including support for code blocks, headers, images (including inline base64 images), tables, lists, blockquotes, and more. It uses the 'org.commonmark' library to parse markdown and renders the resulting node tree using Compose UI elements.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class to hold styling details for inline markdown elements such as code snippets and links.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a rendered markdown table, indicating whether it is a header row and containing a list of cell contents.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Holds information about an inline base64-encoded image, including MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable function that takes markdown text and renders it as styled UI.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Recursive function to process and render different markdown block nodes.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a paragraph node, including handling inline images.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders a bullet list block with proper indentation.

methods.name: RenderOrderedList
methods.description: Renders an ordered list block with numbering.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items, supporting task list markers.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Handles rendering of markdown table blocks with support for headers and cells.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Constructs a list of table rows from the parsed table nodes.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads table header or body sections and converts them into row data.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads individual table rows and their cells converting them into displayable data.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds an AnnotatedString for inline markdown parsing results.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Recursively appends markdown inline nodes to an AnnotatedString.Builder with proper styling.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from inline markdown nodes.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Detects and extracts inline base64 images embedded in markdown paragraphs.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses data URLs for inline base64 images.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Determines text style for markdown headers based on heading level.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Displays an image from base64 encoded data inline within markdown content.
